title: Destructive actions
description: Resolve targets and enforce safety boundaries before irreversible mutation.
purpose: Prevent ambiguous, catastrophic, or unowned changes.
requirements: destructive-actions/resolve-target: Resolve exact files, directories, resources, and mutation boundaries before any destructive or irreversible operation.
destructive-actions/preserve-denies: Retain emergency denies for catastrophic, secret-exposing, or out-of-scope operations even when broad authority is available.

destructive-actions/installer-owned-overwrite: An installer-authoritative overwrite may replace only a declared owned destination after containment and payload validation; preserve every unowned neighbor.
destructive-actions/stop-on-uncertainty: Stop before mutation when a target, containment check, authorization, or validation result is missing or ambiguous.
invariants: Resolve exact targets and retain emergency denies even under full access.
